create_multimodality_dataset: create a MultiModalityDataset from a list of ModalityDatasetItem objects with different modalities
get_batch_samplers_with_ratios: get batch samplers for each dataset using multiplication ratios to increase or decrease sample counts
collate_multimodality_samples: collate samples from the same dataset and add mode metadata to the net_input
create_langpair_mask_dataset: create a LangPairMaskDataset that masks source tokens randomly or from the tail with a given ratio
wrap_file_audio_dataset: wrap a FileAudioDataset to rename source to src_tokens and remove src_lengths and alignment fields
